args.prompt: the printing press runs, spitting out stamped pages that pile up and flutter; far in the background a single small, soft camera flash pops once; the press stays the focus Painterly neo-noir graphic-novel animation: keep the hand-painted brushwork, ink lines and lighting of the first frame, same characters, faces and outfits throughout, smooth cinematic camera, no on-screen text changes.
args.negative_prompt: garbled or changing text, morphing faces, extra limbs, flicker, photorealistic, glossy 3D render, oversaturated neon, smoke or spray shooting out of objects, liquid, mist jets
